-"""Pull lines out of an app log by level: python logscan.py app.log WARNING"""
+"""Pull lines out of an app log by level: python logscan.py app.log WARNING
+
+Returns lines at the given level and anything more serious."""
 import sys
 
 LEVELS = ["DEBUG", "INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR", "CRITICAL"]  # least to most serious
@@ -14,7 +16,13 @@ def filter_lines(lines, level):
     level = level.upper()
     if level not in LEVELS:
         raise ValueError(f"unknown level {level}")
-    return [line for line in lines if line_level(line) == level]
+    threshold = LEVELS.index(level)
+    result = []
+    for line in lines:
+        found = line_level(line)
+        if found is not None and LEVELS.index(found) >= threshold:
+            result.append(line)
+    return result
